frames.cut.sigma: f = the drawn start e0, snapped to the crossed centreline, as a fraction of the parent face E1 OBB major axis (outer cycle on a holed parent); sigma of N(0.5, sigma) + eps * U(0, 1) by maximum likelihood on bentcut_anchor grids; not fitted below n = 10
frames.cut.cornerMid: one-bend cuts with |t - 0.5| <= 0.10, t = |e0 Pv| / (|e0 Pv| + |Pv eN|) between the snapped ends
frames.cut.arrival85: junction ends of the cut arriving at >= 85 degrees to the crossed road (bentcut_geometry)
frames.cut.fillet: one-bend cuts whose bend is drawn as a multi-vertex arc
frames.cutLength: UNREGISTERED measure (no V12 catalogue id; plan-check PC-02): fillet-free course length between the snapped ends, mu; rel_fp_short = / the map median footprint OBB short side
frames.blockArea: bounded leaf faces created by the set's cuts (the immediate children that stopped), mu2; areaRel = / the map median footprint area (block.areaRel); m2_declared at 0.35 m per mu (inference)
